name: Custom GTK CSS
description: Keeps your own GTK CSS alive across Ambxst's theme regeneration. Ambxst rewrites ~/.config/gtk-3.0/gtk.css and ~/.config/gtk-4.0/gtk.css from scratch on every colour change, so anything added to them by hand is lost. With this mod the generated file ends with @import url("custom.css") whenever a custom.css exists next to it, so your overrides live in a file the shell never touches and can also redefine the generated colours.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Appends an @import line to the generated ~/.config/gtk-3.0/gtk.css and ~/.config/gtk-4.0/gtk.css when a custom.css exists beside them
